name: Runtime Reliability & Performance
source: Prevention migration: existing resource, concurrency, retry and workload obligations
why: Inspect applicable execution paths against the declared workload and authorization. Use actual failure/latency/resource evidence; do not invent scale requirements.

checks.check: Resources acquired must be released on every path: an acquire with no context manager and no try/finally.
checks.why_not_a_checker: 今日喺目標 repo 揾唔到實例。對一條預防規則嚟講,呢個係健康嘅樣,唔係規則假。

checks.check: Shared mutable state written from more than one execution unit must be synchronised.

checks.check: No synchronous blocking I/O inside an async hot path.

checks.check: Outbound operations have a finite effective timeout/deadline at the caller, client or enclosing operation boundary.

checks.check: Retries have a budget and a backoff — no unbounded loop whose except branch continues without an attempt limit or a sleep.

checks.check: Expensive client construction is scoped to avoid measured or credible per-request resource churn; reuse must preserve correct ownership and isolation.

checks.check: Inspect queries in loops for N+1 or unbounded work; use batching where required by the actual workload and latency/resource budget.

checks.check: Development hot reload must not create unbounded duplicate database connections; use lifecycle cleanup/reuse appropriate to the runtime.
